einstellungen.text: You can buy anything now. Except the one person who won't talk to you anymore.
Eleven messages to Mia. Not one of them read.
For four days now, you've been sitting alone on your bench.
You always thought money makes problems smaller. So far, it's only made you smaller.
You've been friends for twelve years. Since the first day of first grade.
At school, Mia sits next to Jonas now. Jonas!
“Dude. She's not mad about the money. She's mad about you.”
Ben's right. And that's the worst part.
In the evening, you walk to the lake. Where you two used to skip stones.
You find a flat stone. It sinks right away.
Thirty million dollars. And there's no one you can tell.
You take the long way through the woods. Just so you don't have to go home.
On the way back, you look into the windows. Everywhere, people are sitting together at the table.
At home, the lights are on. Mom is standing in the hallway, half into her jacket.
Twenty minutes later, you're standing in the hospital. The monitor beeps softly.
Grandpa opens his eyes. And the first thing he whispers is: “So you found it.”
